checks.description: Two actually visited primary sources with URLs and dates.
Correct distinction between GitHub Pages static hosting and agent execution.
Correct description of free public hosting versus possible paid compute/model costs.

Maintains later retry after explicit rejection.
Distinct tests for ack, rejection, unknown and later calls.

Verified safe file write, or complete Markdown fallback when writing unavailable.
Honest new-chat, memory and hotlink limitations.
No invented action, source or permission claim.
